prompt: Swap two elements of an ArrayList in place. Complete the swap method so it exchanges the elements at positions i and j and returns the very same list object.
explanation: ArrayList.set(index, value) replaces the element at an index and is the in-place counterpart of get. A classic three-step swap saves one element in a temporary variable so it is not lost when the first set overwrites it. Because the method mutates and returns the list it received, no new list is ever created.
hints: list.get(i) reads an element; list.set(i, value) overwrites the element at that index.
Save list.get(i) in a temporary String variable before you overwrite position i.
After the two set calls, return the same list variable that was passed in -- do not create a new ArrayList.
